required_invariants.description: Clinical content segregation, AAL2/MFA and RLS authorization boundaries must be proven.
Money remains integer cents across persistence, calculations and UI/API boundaries.
Agenda, financial and fiscal state machines remain independent and historically compatible.
Financial and fiscal external effects are idempotent, reconciled and safe under retry/concurrency.
Critical auth, agenda, financial and fiscal journeys must be exercised in the real browser.
Backup integrity, restore and rollback/recovery path must be proven before production readiness.
Live external providers remain disabled outside production.
Development/test validation uses synthetic data and does not expose real patient data.
